network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs through Bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, a writable temporary output directory, fixed locale/timezone, and one Lean worker thread. Host-side hash and Git checks make no network request. This is warm-cache node evidence, not cold hermetic release evidence.
scope_boundary: Network-isolated, trust-level-zero, target-scoped worker replay of the exact statement, analytic proof packages, frozen composition, exact root, selected provenance, and a same-worker differential composition. The obligation IDs describe observed provisional proof coverage only. Proof master acceptance, accepted foundation/profile state, complete transitive declaration and TCB provenance, clean-checkout empty-cache offline replay, SBOM/archive closure, and distinct signed independent verification remain fail-closed.
